purpose: Read-only historical and public Spotify research with Gary's recorded catalog-candidate decisions; no catalog, database, or storage mutation.
research_method: Public web pages only; no Spotify authentication or Spotify API was used.

historical_themes.original_performer_or_orchestra: not established in this research batch

historical_themes.lyricist: Frederick Herbert (lyrics added 1961; the 1959 theme was instrumental)
historical_themes.original_performer_or_orchestra: Orchestra conducted by Stanley Wilson on the 1959 Original TV Music from Wagon Train LP

spotify_candidate.album: Cowboy Party! Classic Western Songs for Your Wild West Cowboy Party!
spotify_candidate.classification_note: Public Spotify metadata identifies Stanley Wilson but the 2012 compilation page does not establish whether this exact edit is the 1959 soundtrack-LP performance or a later reissue/edit.

programs.listening_note: Gary approved this exact recording for the catalog candidate list. It still targets the 1959 instrumental Wagons Ho!, and its exact Spotify release lineage remains uncertain.

historical_themes.composer: credited to Ray Llewellyn; probably David Rose
historical_themes.lyricist: Patricia La Salle added lyrics later; original television theme was instrumental
historical_themes.original_performer_or_orchestra: broadcast performance not established in this research batch

spotify_candidate.track_title: Sea Hunt Theme (From the TV Series Sea Hunt)
spotify_candidate.classification_note: Public Spotify search results identify the Buddy Morrow track and album, but did not expose a reliable track-level Spotify URL or ID. The 1959 Impact LP is historically documented as a Buddy Morrow recording.

programs.listening_note: Gary approved the documented 1959 Buddy Morrow commercial recording as a catalog candidate. It is not confirmed as the broadcast master; no Spotify track ID is asserted.

historical_themes.original_performer_or_orchestra: The Mellomen in the television miniseries; Fess Parker was the title performer and recorded a commercial version

spotify_candidate.track_title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett - From the Television Miniseries Davy Crockett
spotify_candidate.album: Fess Parker Cowboy and Indian Songs
spotify_candidate.classification_note: The public Spotify page dates this release to 1969; it is appropriately labelled for the television miniseries but is not established as the 1954 broadcast recording.

programs.listening_note: Gary approved this exact recording for the catalog candidate list. Preserve that it is a 1969 rerecording, not the confirmed 1954 broadcast recording.

approval_gate: Wagon Train, Sea Hunt, and Davy Crockett are Gary-approved catalog candidates only, unranked and unapplied to the production database. Sea Hunt has no defensible Spotify track ID. No final ranks or production changes are authorized.
